segments.name: blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to effect a business combination with one or more businesses, focused on defense technology, advanced computing, software and media.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on November 13, 2025 as a Cayman Islands exempted company and formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which we refer to throughout this Report as our initial business combination.
